section_summary: This section contains an alphabetical run of profiles of machine-tool and related manufacturers, from Hibi Tekkosho through Seiki Tanko K.K. Most profiles give a founding date, capitalization, products, plant location, and sources; employment and production estimates are usually unknown. The firms are concentrated in Japan, with several plants listed in Manchuria.
